## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover every public behavior change.
- [ ] A Changeset describes every public API or behavior change (`bun run changeset`).
- [ ] Generated files are regenerated, not edited (`generate:bindings`, `generate:public-api`).
- [ ] Documentation describes the new behavior.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits.
